plan.notes: Source: official ASUN AY2026-2027 degree plan PDF (CIP 30.9999; Degree Code 0517; revision date 01/28/2026). Semester sums 12+16+16+16 = 60, matching the printed total. This umbrella plan covers the AAS GT Pathway programs: Advanced Manufacturing Technology, Computer Aided Design, Cosmetology, Culinary Arts Food Service Management, Diesel Technology, Energy Control Technology, High Voltage Lineman Technology, Industrial Maintenance, Machining, Practical Nursing, and Welding (source page 2). Major/Supporting Technical Discipline courses must come from those pathways. Course codes/titles transcribed verbatim, including the plan's older numbering (ENGL 10003 Composition I; ENGL 10203 Workplace Essentials, ACTS ENGL2023; ENGL 10203 Composition II in the Year 1 second-semester choice block). Year 2 semester headers use an en dash in the source.
